slides.texte_overlay:
weekend habits that make
monday feel easy

a real lie in

sleep in on saturday, but get up at a normal time on sunday. keeping sunday close to your usual rhythm makes monday morning feel much less like a shock.

an afternoon outside

spend at least one afternoon outdoors, far from screens: a hike, a park, a long walk. fresh air on the weekend recharges you far more than any series on a screen ever will.

one small reset

clean your space and wash your clothes before sunday evening. walking into monday with everything ready removes half the stress before the week even begins.

something new to think about

spend 5 minutes on sunday learning something completely unrelated to work: a myth, a planet, a painter. a curious mind starts the whole week feeling lighter.

plan just three things

write down the three things that matter most this week. a short list feels possible, and finishing it gives you a real, satisfying sense of progress by friday.
